research.title: Occlusion Sensitivity in Visual Object Detection
bullets: Designed controlled experiments comparing object detectors under synthetic occlusion, varying mask placement and coverage while preserving consistent evaluation splits.
Analyzed localization and classification errors by object size and occlusion pattern, distinguishing missed detections from inaccurate bounding box predictions.

research.title: Boundary Robustness in Semantic Segmentation
bullets: Designed experiments comparing segmentation models under image resizing and compression, using matched training settings to isolate preprocessing effects.
Analyzed boundary accuracy and classwise overlap, inspecting prediction maps to characterize errors around thin structures and adjacent object regions.

research.title: Confidence Calibration Under Visual Domain Shift
bullets: Designed experiments evaluating temperature scaling and ensemble confidence estimates for image classifiers exposed to lighting changes and image corruptions.
Analyzed reliability diagrams, calibration errors, and selective prediction curves, examining how validation domain choice affected confidence estimates across shifted conditions.

publications.title: Validation Domain Choice in Confidence Calibration for Image Classification Under Visual Shift

work.title: Image Processing Service Maintenance
bullets: Implemented image upload validation and thumbnail generation within an existing service, handling malformed files and preserving consistent output dimensions.
Maintained automated tests for image processing endpoints, investigated production failures, and updated error handling for unsupported formats and interrupted requests.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Image Retrieval Representations
bullets: Implemented image retrieval pipelines using color histograms and pretrained convolutional features, applying consistent normalization and distance calculations across representations.
Compared ranked retrieval results using precision and recall, inspecting failures involving background similarity, viewpoint variation, and visually similar categories.

projects.title: Classical and Learned Approaches to Image Denoising
bullets: Implemented bilateral filtering and a convolutional denoising autoencoder, generating matched noisy inputs to support controlled comparisons across restoration approaches.
Evaluated reconstruction quality using peak signal to noise ratio and structural similarity, inspecting texture preservation and edge blurring across noise conditions.

projects.title: Feature Matching for Planar Image Alignment
bullets: Implemented corner detection, local patch descriptors, and robust homography estimation to align image pairs depicting approximately planar scenes.
Compared descriptor matching strategies under rotation and illumination changes, analyzing reprojection errors and alignment failures caused by repetitive textures.
